FICTIONAL TEST DOCUMENT — NOT LAW. Used only by automated tests.
SAMPLE TREATY ON CLOUD GARDENS
Article 1
Definitions
For the purposes of this Treaty, "cloud garden" means a fictional garden floating above the sea of glass.
Article 2
Registration of widgets in cloud gardens
Contracting Parties shall keep a register of widgets crafted in cloud gardens, as provided in
Article 1 of this Treaty.
Article 3
Sharing of rainbow seeds
Contracting Parties shall share rainbow seeds collected from cloud gardens fairly among gardeners.
